setlist_extra.title: Bird Song/Set Break With Carlos Santana

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (3 reviews): Bob broke into a huge grin about thirty seconds into the opener, signaling a special show; Jack Straw launches out of the gate at full speed [16][17][19]
- **Bird Song** (1 review, 2 other sources): Bird Song ran about seventeen minutes with Santana sitting in, setting up the second set; Carlos Santana plays on Bird Song [3][6][22]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-04-28.at853.lech.116859.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 163 min [1]
- **gd1991-04-28.sbd.miller.92278.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 164 min; rated 4.11/5 by 9 [3]
- **gd91-04-28.neumann.vernon.8196.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 161 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [10]. Said about its sound: Audience recording with extraordinary bass response; U89 mics; Garcia's vocals sit low in the mix [18]
- **gd91-04-28.sbd.vernon.6112.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 155 min; rated 4.07/5 by 28 [12]. Said about its sound: Sound at Jack Straw was pristine and very loud, much better than the previous show's poor sound; Recording is full and rich in Phil's bass, with heavy bombs throughout; Sound quality described as rich, thick and solid [16][17][21][23][24][25]

## Around the show

- Phil spent a long while adjusting his system before the show; the band then opened with Jack Straw [16]
- This late-April Las Vegas run was the first there for the two new members, Welnick and Hornsby [19]
- Lyrics with multiple meanings stood out, including gambling references fitting for Las Vegas [21]
- A man ran onstage during Deal and Jerry did not flinch [22]
- Commenter recalls this being part of a Saturday and Sunday Las Vegas pair with Santana [29]
- Bass character compared to the Phish Big Cypress recording made with front-of-board U89 mics [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-04-28.at853.lech.116859.flac16**: taped by John Lech; transferred by Jeff Bowen;Brad Foster; source: Source: (FOB) AT853a [cardioids/xy] > Panasonic SV-255; [1]. Also: Audience taping with mics at head height on a custom XY bar atop a blacked-out car antenna; Taped by John, transfer shared by Jeff; discs extracted in secure mode, joined and re-tracked by set [1]
- **gd1991-04-28.sbd.miller.92278.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> Dat -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> CD DSet 2: SBD -> Dat (44.1k) [3]. Also: Hybrid source: set one is straight soundboard feed, set two comes from the UltraMatrix mix [3]
- **gd91-04-28.neumann.vernon.8196.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB Neumann U87's > ? > CDR [10]
- **gd91-04-28.sbd.vernon.6112.sbeok.shnf**: source: Purported: SBD> Phil Lesh's cassette master> DAT> CDR [12]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1991-04-27 Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, U.N.L.V., Las Vegas, NV, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1991-04-27-sam-boyd-silver-bowl-u-n-l-v-las-vegas-nv-usa/) [34]
- Poster by Philip Andelman Grateful Dead: [1991-04-28 Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, U.N.L.V., Las Vegas, NV, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1991-04-28-sam-boyd-silver-bowl-u-n-l-v-las-vegas-nv-usa/) [35]
